column1: # Modules the auth binaries (cmd/auth-service, cmd/auth-migrate) may link.
# `ci/check_go.sh auth closure` fails when `go list -deps` of those two commands
# reaches a module not listed here (CHAOS-10131). Columns: module<TAB>reason.
# standard library first and pgx/v5 for PostgreSQL (item 5); it carries no
# machine-readable list, so this file is the list. ClickHouse (clickhouse-go,
# ch-go) is never allowed: the auth service holds signing keys and uses no
# analytics store. Add a row only with a named reason.

column2: OTLP metrics export (internal/platform/otlpmetrics via api/apimetrics); CHAOS-10131 keeps the exporter
OTLP gRPC exporter: the named reason for gRPC below
named reason: transport of the OTLP gRPC exporter (otlpmetricgrpc)
internal/auth/edgetoken: the one Go copy of the HS256 ops access-token decision (go-api parity; HS256 stays until Wave 3), used by the session routes (CHAOS-10228)
internal/auth/contracts (wire types and schema validation), linked once the session domain is mounted (CHAOS-10228)
bcrypt (and its blowfish) for the local login password check, go-api parity (internal/auth/identity/local, internal/auth/passwordhash); linked once login is mounted (CHAOS-10392)
